literal_meaning: হারা (পরাজয়) এবং হারি (পুনরাবৃত্তি বা সমানতা নির্দেশক)
similar_in_english: a mixed bag of wins and losses
example_sentences_in_english: Victory and defeat are inevitable in life.
The match ended in a hara-hari situation.
note: This idiom reflects the balanced nature of success and failure in Bengali cultural expressions, often used in contexts of games or life's uncertainties.
